explication: 12306-mcp exposes 12306 ticket-search capabilities as MCP tools and a station-data resource, over stdio or HTTP. The main workflow is an MCP client request routed to a search tool, which resolves station codes, queries 12306 and returns formatted/filtered results; the README also documents filtering, route-stop queries and transfer searches. Most runtime behavior is concentrated in src/index.ts, so several distinct responsibilities share that path. The excerpt shows only selected implementation sections; documented but unsampled features are represented without guessing their internal calls.
